skills.detail:
Creates a marker at mid-range that only you can see.
While the skill button is held down, damage received from enemies is reduced, and the marker can be moved.

You will be moved to the marker's location and the marker will disappear after a certain period of time or when the skill button is released.
Deals a long-range attack with a Knockback effect as well as a chance to inflict Marked.
Afterward, moves the user to the location where the skill was activated.

Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
skills.name: Sharpshooter

skills.detail:
When "Warp" is used, Skill 2 will transform into the Combo Skill "What a Tough Guard" for a set period of time.
Skill 2 turns back into "Warp" after a certain amount of time passes.

When There Are Enemies Inflicted with Marked:
Moves the user to the location of the furthest enemy inflicted with Marked and deals a multiple hit attack that inflicts an ATK debuff.

When There Are No Enemies Inflicted with Marked:
Moves the user towards enemies at long range and deals a multiple hit attack that inflicts an ATK debuff.

Afterward, moves the user to the location where the skill was activated.
Damage dealt will disregard damage reduction.
Attack ignores obstacles.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
skills.name: Warp
